description: Read the Contribution Analysis table from the Bridge sheet (column E and right). Returns headers, product names, and a 2-D values matrix. Returns null if Bridge has not been built yet. Use this (with get_chart_data + get_insights) to write a DETAILED final analysis: call out the biggest positive/negative contributors BY NAME with their values, plus Added/Removed Data rows — don't just restate the headline.
name: get_contribution_table
